title: Everyday Phrases — The Performance Review
scene_zh: 績效評估 · 情境對話
title_quote: Hi Anna, did you get the invite?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】💼 實用績效評估必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱B1 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — The Performance Review
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄績效評估情境對話：從收到面談邀請、填寫自評，到會議室談成果、改進項目、晉升與加薪，一共 400 句常用英文短句（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多職場場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical The Performance Review phrase pairs, from getting the meeting invite and writing a self-review, to discussing results, improvements, promotion and a raise (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more workplace scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi Anna, did you get the invite?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ˈænə, dɪd ju ɡɛt ði ɪnˈvaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜，你收到邀請了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 收到了，我們的評估排在週四。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three o'clock in the big room.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 大概二十分鐘就能填完。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll start it right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Describe three wins from this quarter.
dialogue.zh: 寫下這一季的三個亮點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The launch was my biggest win.
dialogue.zh: 產品上線是我最大的成績。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you hit your sales target?
dialogue.zh: 你的銷售目標達標了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I reached one hundred five percent.
dialogue.zh: 我做到了百分之一百零五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. Put that number in writing.
dialogue.zh: 不錯，把這個數字寫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I already added it to the form.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɔlˈrɛdi ˈædəd ɪt tə ðə fɔrm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you ask the team for feedback?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju æsk ðə tim fər ˈfidbæk?/
dialogue.zh: 你有向團隊收集反饋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sam sent me two notes today.
dialogue.zh: 山姆今天給我發了兩條。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He likes how I share updates.
dialogue.zh: 他喜歡我同步進度的方式。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 反饋裡有批評的意見嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He wants quicker replies from me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I won't hide it in the meeting.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ woʊnt haɪd ɪt ɪn ðə ˈmitɪŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 把你的項目看板也帶來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 需要把圖表打印出來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One page is enough for us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Prepare one story about a problem.
dialogue.zh: 準備一個解決問題的故事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 供應商延誤那件事很適合。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 要講清楚你是怎麼解決的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. End with the lesson learned.
dialogue.zh: 很好，最後總結一下教訓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I now keep a risk list.
dialogue.zh: 我現在會維護一份風險清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你會對週四感到緊張嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's a conversation, not a trial.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which courses did you take recently?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did they help your daily work?
dialogue.zh: 它們對你的日常工作有幫助嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the Excel course saved time.
dialogue.zh: 有，Excel 課幫我省了時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mention that in the goals section.
dialogue.zh: 這一點寫進目標欄目裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 有數字，說法才更有說服力。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, I'll add the hours saved.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt, aɪl æd ði ˈaʊərz seɪvd./
dialogue.zh: 明白，我把省下的工時加上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who covered your leave last month?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write down questions for me too.
dialogue.zh: 把要問我的問題也寫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 準備充分能體現專業度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hope I sound clear there.
dialogue.zh: 希望我到時候能講清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you update the shared folder?
dialogue.zh: 共享文件夾你更新了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My files went up this morning.
dialogue.zh: 我的文件早上就傳上去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep it simple, bullet points help.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are your March goals still open?
dialogue.zh: 你三月的目標還沒結項嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two are done, one is moving.
dialogue.zh: 兩個完成了，一個還在推進。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 已完成的要清楚標出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我會在每條旁邊標日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 培訓目標是被什麼卡住了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Note that as an external reason.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is teamwork in your group?
dialogue.zh: 你們小組的協作怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 現在任務分配挺公平的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這一點值得寫進去，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you finish the draft form?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 差不多了，還有一欄空著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That support question at the end.
dialogue.zh: 最後那個需要支持的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我需要多一個數據平台的授權。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put it in that box then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you test the screen share?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, I'll try after lunch.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The room projector can be tricky.
dialogue.zh: 會議室的投影儀有點難搞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我正需要呢，謝謝你，馬克。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you in the meeting room.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Come in, Anna, have a seat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's begin with what went well.
dialogue.zh: 我們先聊聊做得好的部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I think the launch went smoothly.
dialogue.zh: 我覺得上線過程挺順利。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Agreed. Your checklist kept everyone on track.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡrid. jɔr ˈtʃɛkˌlɪst kɛpt ˈɛvriˌwʌn ɑn træk./
dialogue.zh: 同意，你的清單讓大家都沒跑偏。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那部分做起來挺有意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I finished at one hundred five.
dialogue.zh: 我最終完成了一百零五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which goal took the most work?
dialogue.zh: 哪個目標花的力氣最多？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 是的，但我們很快追回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How did you fix the schedule?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I moved tasks to two people.
dialogue.zh: 我把任務分給了兩個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 聰明，你越來越會分派任務了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What else are you proud of?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 接下來是稍微難一點的話題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 對，有兩位同事跟我反饋過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 他們說等回覆要等好幾天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know some replies were slow.
dialogue.zh: 我知道有些回得確實慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I was buried in the launch.
dialogue.zh: 那陣子我被上線工作淹沒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I get it, but they felt ignored.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɡɛt ɪt, bʌt ðeɪ fɛlt ɪɡˈnɔrd./
dialogue.zh: 我理解，但他們覺得被無視了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I focused, but I ignored chats.
dialogue.zh: 我只顧埋頭做事，忽略了消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I agree, it hurt the team.
dialogue.zh: 我同意，這確實影響了團隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這些內容有讓你意外的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, but it rings true.
dialogue.zh: 有一點，但說的都是事實。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我會每天在中午前回覆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 延誤背後有什麼阻礙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 哪些會你其實可以不參加？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 週一的進度會也許可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你的分析工作一直很出色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那就要保護好這個優勢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 坦誠的對話一開始總有點尬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 很高興我們把話說開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 山姆的反饋和我提的一致嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 一致，只是他措辭更委婉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 真實的反饋會彼此印證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 對我記錄的這些有疑問嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 能舉一個具體的例子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 還有一次，是共享盤的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那個調研最後結果如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們收到了一百份回覆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 其實比目標多了十五份。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 今天你覺得被傾聽了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 話可以難講，氣氛不必緊張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 要不要休息一下喝口水？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你的彙報幻燈片很清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I spent a weekend on them.
dialogue.zh: 我花了整個週末做它們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那我以後會更早喊超載。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 說定了，這樣壓力小多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 外加一個改進點：回覆速度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 先休息一下，再談下一步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 歡迎回來，我們聊聊成長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which skill would move your career forward?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪʧ skɪl wʊd muv jɔr kəˈrɪr ˈfɔrwərd?/
dialogue.zh: 哪項技能能推動你的職涯？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Could I register for it right away?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd aɪ ˈrɛdʒɪstər fər ɪt raɪt əˈweɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 第二，你自己主持一次會議。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我會準備一份簡短議程。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我現在就把時間鎖出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 兩個保持穩定，一個要有挑戰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我就挑戰調研那個目標。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我需要儘早拿到數據權限。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 他在報告方面需要指點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你對自己未來怎麼規劃？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 兩年內做到資深分析師。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 從現在的位置看很實際。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lead a project end to end.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The portal upgrade could be mine.
dialogue.zh: 門戶升級那個項目我可以接。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 選得好，那個項目受關注。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 表現紮實，有一個明顯短板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, fix it, four is close.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You told me: twice a year.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 也許可以再換副好耳機？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine keeps cutting out on calls.
dialogue.zh: 我的耳機開會時總斷線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 想，我很希望多上台報告。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 太好了，準備時間很充裕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那個挑戰性目標讓我發怵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我每個月也會跟你對一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 要調整你的工作時間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friday is my deep work day.
dialogue.zh: 週五是專心深度工作的日子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What would you change around here?
dialogue.zh: 你覺得我們哪裡該改進？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 有道理，我每月發書面紀錄給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這就解決了臨時吃驚的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 目標裡還有不清楚的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 只有帶新人要花多少時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那我們就用這個話題收尾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You'll get a five percent raise.
dialogue.zh: 你會得到百分之五的加薪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那就是下一個發薪週期。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 有這個數字我就能做計劃了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 今天把會議紀要寫出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 列出目標、日期和負責人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I send it to you?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll finish it at my desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 每個月的第一個週三可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這個計劃還有別的問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. Half a year, one clear step.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd. hæf ə jɪr, wʌn klɪr stɛp./
dialogue.zh: 很好，半年時間，一步走穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 寫個簡短的小結，對我有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 總結決定事項和時間點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, cc HR as well?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll send it within the hour.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That was lighter than I feared.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我本來就是這麼打算的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anna, you're home! Did it go okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈænə, jʊr hoʊm! dɪd ɪt ɡoʊ oʊˈkeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你回來了！還順利嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You sound different from this morning.
dialogue.zh: 你聽起來和早上不一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你這一年越來越有盼頭了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It helps to have a plan.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 成長通常從不舒服開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 來點慶祝感的，比如麵條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell me how the notes go.
dialogue.zh: 紀要寫得怎麼樣記得告訴我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Speedy! Did you include the goals?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 發送之後給我發個消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do you feel right now?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tired after honest talk is normal.
dialogue.zh: 坦誠溝通後疲憊很正常。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你會反覆想著那些批評嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm learning to shrug it off.
dialogue.zh: 我在學著不把話放心上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He says coffee is on him.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll sleep like a stone tonight.
